To Registered Trade Operators,

Thank you for your continued support and cooperation with our services.

We will be conducting maintenance on the Trade-Related Certificate Online Issue System, with the release to the production environment scheduled as follows.

During this period, system operation will be temporarily suspended. Please note this when planning your use.

Release Date:
Tuesday, July 21, 2026 (Reiwa 8)

Maintenance Period:
Friday, July 17, 2026 (Reiwa 8), 7:00 p.m. through Tuesday, July 21, 2026, 8:00 a.m.

Important Notes During Maintenance:

Applicants may submit applications through the Trade-Related Certificate Online Issue System during the above period, but certificates will not be issued until July 21 (Tuesday) or later.

If you have urgent needs, please consider submitting your application in advance or using the paper application method.

We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your understanding and cooperation.

Source (Japanese): https://www.hanno-cci.or.jp/xo_event/xo_event-2724/
